constructor.notice: Deploy EBrake with the comptroller, ACM, and comptroller type flag.

pauseActions(address[],uint8[]).notice: Pause multiple actions on multiple markets in one call.

pauseBorrow(address).notice: Pause borrow on a single market.         Blocks new borrows. Existing borrowers can still repay.

pauseFlashLoan().notice: Pause flash loans across the core pool.

pauseRedeem(address).notice: Pause redeem on a single market.         Blocks withdrawals. Use when draining must be stopped immediately.

pauseSupply(address).notice: Pause supply (mint) on a single market.         Blocks new deposits. Existing suppliers can still redeem.

pauseTransfer(address).notice: Pause transfer of vTokens on a single market.         Blocks vToken movement, prevents attacker from moving stolen collateral.

setCFZero(address).notice: Set collateral factor to zero for a market across all relevant pools.         Liquidation threshold is left unchanged.         Blocks new borrows against the asset. Does NOT make existing positions liquidatable —         that would require lowering LT, which this contract cannot do.

setCFZero(address,uint96).notice: Set collateral factor to zero for a market in a specific pool.         Same safety guarantees as setCFZero(address) — LT is left unchanged.

setMarketBorrowCaps(address[],uint256[]).notice: Decrease borrow caps on markets. Can only set caps LOWER than or equal to current values.         Setting to 0 blocks all new borrows. Existing borrows are never affected by caps.

setMarketSupplyCaps(address[],uint256[]).notice: Decrease supply caps on markets. Can only set caps LOWER than or equal to current values.         Setting to 0 blocks all new deposits. Existing deposits are never affected by caps.

userdoc.notice: A standalone emergency action router for Venus Protocol.         This contract holds NO detection logic — it only exposes Comptroller emergency         functions behind ACM permissions. See IEBrake for full design documentation.
